description: This file defines the AuditLogTableConfig class, which extends EntityTableConfig to configure and manage the display and interaction with audit log data in a table format within the application. It includes methods for fetching audit logs, translating entity types, action types, and statuses, and opening detail dialogs.

classes.name: AuditLogTableConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for displaying audit logs in a table, including data fetching, translation, and dialog display functionalities.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the table configuration with dependencies and sets up columns, actions, and fetch functions based on audit log mode.

methods.name: getEntityTypeTranslation
methods.description: Returns the translated string for a given entity type or alias.

methods.name: getActionTypeTranslation
methods.description: Returns the translated string for a given action type.

methods.name: getActionStatusTranslation
methods.description: Returns the translated string for a given action status.

methods.name: fetchAuditLogs
methods.description: Fetches audit logs based on the current audit log mode and filters.

methods.name: showAuditLogDetails
methods.description: Opens a dialog to show detailed information about a specific audit log entry.
